C0982.title: Delta Force: 10-Year Ban for Boosting with Cheaters
C0982.summary: Delta Force imposes severe penalties for boosting with cheaters. Players who actively team up with cheating accounts or frequently group with suspicious accounts can face a ban of up to ten years, reflecting the game's zero-tolerance policy toward boosting services.
